column1: # model-two-readers 2026-10-15/16: ten one-page files (/private/tmp/mt/in, five newspaper, five other) through score-gate, accurate mode on, concurrency 6, each leg alone under the heavy lock, 18 GB Mac.
# variant base = origin/main ff798aa (one reading at a time); new = this change (two at once); new reps 1-2 lacked the retry-alone, reps 3-4 are the committed code.
# fallbacks = pages whose model reading was stopped and kept Vision's; max_pressure = kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level sampled every 2 s.
# Session 2 (2026-10-16, 01:00-02:30). The gate's own wall_s above is rounded UP to its 20 s completion timer (score-gate
# polls model.isRunning every 20 s), which is why every Falcon leg read 162/182/202 s. end_s below is the last
# published PDF's mtime minus the leg's start, the batch's real end. variant prev = 9c2c8b9 (two slots, taken in no
# order), new = longest page first (ReaderTicket), base = ff798aa (one reader). nl = new with a per-call timing log.
# Means of end_s. Falcon-OCR: base 170.4, new 148.2 (three legs with nl) -13.0%, prev 152.2 -10.7%. FAILS 15%.
# PaddleOCR-VL: base 101.0, new 82.4, -18.4%. PASSES. nl's log: both slots busy from 2.1 s to 139.9 s; a Falcon page
# read beside another took 1.5-1.6x its time alone (52-67 s against 30-44 s alone in model-throughput rep 2), so two slots do ~1.13x one's work.
